name: EES: a stay that began before 10 April 2026 is left out

planSteps.description: Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2026-04-01 and exit 2026-04-20 (data-testid=trip-entry, trip-exit), and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
Enter 0 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) and click compare (data-testid=ees-compare)
The findings list (data-testid=ees-codes) has data-codes exactly 'ees-ignores-pre-cutoff-stay' and shows 'EES leaves out pre-10 April 2026 stays'
The cutoff note (data-testid=ees-cutoff-note) has data-days 20 and says 0 days are comparable with the EES
